feeds.title: Prosci Change Management Learning Center Blog
feeds.description: Prosci, the world's largest body of change management helps you stay change-ready. It combines scientific research with the people side of change to deliver results-focused solutions that enable clients to achieve change outcomes and grow organizational change capability and enhances your ability to manage change in the new reality. Subscribe for the latest cutting-edge research, articles, and tips.

feeds.title: Kotter
feeds.description: Kotter is a strategy execution, change management, and transformation consulting firm founded by renowned leadership expert Dr. John Kotter. Kotter's mission is to guide, educate, and inspire people so that they can become significantly better leaders, successfully transform organizations into truly great enterprises, and build a better world for future generations. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: Change! | Change Management Tools
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Christopher Smith and I'm the lead author for change.walkme.com. This blog provides the latest change management tips, tutorials, and news on some of the issues, challenges, and ideas circulating in the change management world today. Follow to keep up with the latest updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Omega Z Advisors | Expert Change Management Consulting Firm
feeds.description: Omega Z Advisors, a change management consulting firm helps leaders and others navigate their internal business cultures and politics to achieve the change they want. Mike Lehr, founder and President of Omega Z Advisors, is an expert change management consultant who worked, writes, and speaks to help people become better influencers and problem solvers. Take advantage of his uniquely effective insights and interactivity to effect the change you want.

feeds.title: Enclaria Blog | Influence Change at Work
feeds.description: Welcome! Thank you for visiting! Heather Stagl, the founder of Enclaria, provides valuable resources to help you lead change in your organization through individual coaching, team workshops, and training programs. Follow this blog if your job is to change the way other people work in your organization.

feeds.title: Daggerwing Group
feeds.description: Daggerwing Group is Omnicom's global Change Consultancy. We believe that a company's pace of growth is tied to the speed of customer and employee behavior change. That's why Daggerwing Group's focus is on helping companies accelerate growth by changing customer and employee behavior, fast.

feeds.title: Torben Rick » Change Management
feeds.description: Torben Rick, an experienced senior executive, both at a strategic and operational level, with a strong track record in developing, driving, and managing business improvement and development, change management and turn-around.

feeds.title: ChangeFolio

ChangeFolio is a specialist in organizational change management, with a focus on 4 key practices that include Consulting, Software, Training, and Behavioural Design.
